# Ezekiel 48 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 48:1 (overlap: 22%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "And-these [are] the-names-of the-tribes: From-the-north end, beside the-way-of Hethlon to-the-entrance-of Hamath, Hazar-enan, the-border-of Damascus northward, beside Hamath — and-they-will-have east-side [and] west-side — Dan, one [portion]." |
| LOGOS | "These are the names of the tribes: Beginning at the northern extreme, beside the way of Hethlon to Lebo-hamath, as far as Hazar-enan (which is on the northern border of Damascus over against Hamath), and extending from the east side to the west, Dan, one portion." |
| PNEUMA | "Here is the list of the tribes and their territories: Dan's territory stretches across the entire northern border, from the Mediterranean through Hethlon and Lebo-hamath to Hazar-enan on the border of Damascus — one portion." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 48:35 (overlap: 22%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | All-around [it will be] eighteen thousand [cubits]; and-the-name-of the-city from-that-day [will-be] 'YHWH [is] There.' |
| LOGOS | The circumference of the city shall be 18,000 cubits. And the name of the city from that time on shall be, The LORD Is There. |
| PNEUMA | The distance around the entire city will be six miles. And from that day the name of the city will be 'The LORD Is There.' |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
